steps.note: Melted so protein, fat and buttermilk form layers.
Until the frothing stops and the curd particles turn golden to brown, where the solids form.
Filtered or centrifuged, by stack filters, pressure filters or centrifugal separators, and the ghee packed at 40–42 °C.
